verdict.rationale: There is no explicit retention or deletion feature in the evidence. Kong offers only indirect control over data. It can run self-hosted or in DB-less and hybrid modes, with AI Gateway logs written to a local file the operator manages (kong-gh-4, kong-gh-7, kong-docs-69). Its AI data-governance DLP policies can strip PII from traffic (kong-docs-60), which limits what gets kept rather than controlling how long it is kept. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods for logs and analytics, documented deletion or purge workflows for Konnect-stored data, retention controls for AI prompts and semantic caches, and independent corroboration.
